paragraphs: White Mountains Insurance Group, Ltd. (the "Company" or the "Registrant") is an exempted Bermuda limited liability company whose principal businesses are conducted through its subsidiaries and affiliates. Within this report, the term "White Mountains" is used to refer to one or more entities within the consolidated organization, as the context requires. The Company's headquarters is located at 26 Reid Street, Hamilton, Bermuda HM 11, its principal executive office is located at 23 South Main Street, Suite 3B, Hanover, New Hampshire 03755-2053 and its registered office is located at Clarendon House, 2 Church Street, Hamilton, Bermuda HM 11. The Company's website is located at www.whitemountains.com. The information contained on White Mountains's website is not incorporated by reference into, and is not a part of, this report.

White Mountains is engaged in the business of making opportunistic and value-oriented acquisitions of businesses and assets in the insurance, financial services and related sectors, operating these businesses and assets through its subsidiaries and, if and when attractive exit valuations become available, disposing of these businesses and assets.

As of December 31, 2025, White Mountains conducted its business primarily in five areas: property and casualty insurance and reinsurance, municipal bond guarantee reinsurance, capital solutions for asset and wealth management firms, specialty insurance distribution and other operations. White Mountains's property and casualty insurance and reinsurance business is conducted through its subsidiary Ark Insurance Holdings Limited and its subsidiaries (collectively, "Ark") and Outrigger Re Ltd. Segregated Account 2023-1 ("WM Outrigger Re") (collectively with Ark, "Ark/WM Outrigger"). White Mountains's municipal bond guarantee reinsurance business is conducted through its subsidiary HG Global Ltd. and its reinsurance subsidiary HG Re Ltd. ("HG Re") (collectively with HG Re, "HG Global"). White Mountains provides capital solutions for asset and wealth management firms through its subsidiary Kudu Investment Management, LLC and its subsidiaries (collectively, "Kudu"). White Mountains's specialty insurance distribution business is conducted through its subsidiary WM Phoenix Parent, L.P. and its subsidiaries d/b/a Distinguished Programs (collectively, "Distinguished"). White Mountains's other operations consist of the Company and its wholly-owned subsidiary, White Mountains Capital, LLC ("WM Capital"), its other intermediate holding companies, its wholly-owned investment management subsidiary, White Mountains Advisors LLC ("WM Advisors"), investment assets managed by WM Advisors, its interests in Bamboo Ide8 Insurance Services LLC ("Bamboo MGA") and its subsidiaries (collectively, "Bamboo") through a special purpose vehicle (the "Bamboo SPV"), MediaAlpha, Inc. ("MediaAlpha"), DavidShield PassportCard Ltd. and its subsidiaries (collectively, "PassportCard/DavidShield"), BroadStreet Partners, Inc. ("BroadStreet") through a special purpose vehicle (the "BroadStreet SPV"), Elementum Holdings LP ("Elementum"), White Mountains Partners LLC ("WTM Partners"), Enterprise Electric, LLC d/b/a Enterprise Solutions ("Enterprise Solutions"), two special purpose collateralized reinsurance vehicles that provide reinsurance capacity to Bamboo (the "Bamboo CRVs"), certain other consolidated and unconsolidated entities ("Other Operating Businesses") and certain other assets (collectively, "Other Operations").

As of December 31, 2025, White Mountains's reportable segments were Ark/WM Outrigger, HG Global, Kudu and Distinguished, with its remaining operating businesses, holding companies and other assets included in Other Operations. On December 5, 2025, White Mountains completed the sale of a controlling financial interest in Bamboo. As a result, White Mountains deconsolidated Bamboo on December 5, 2025, and Bamboo is no longer a reportable segment. Through December 5, 2025, Bamboo's results of operations are presented within the Bamboo segment.
The Ark/WM Outrigger segment consists of Ark and WM Outrigger Re.

On January 1, 2021, White Mountains acquired a controlling ownership interest in Ark (the "Ark Transaction"). Ark is a specialty property and casualty insurance and reinsurance company that offers a wide range of niche insurance and reinsurance products, including property, specialty, marine & energy, casualty and accident & health.

During the fourth quarter of 2022, Ark sponsored the formation of Outrigger Re Ltd., a Bermuda company registered as a special purpose insurer and segregated accounts company, to provide collateralized reinsurance protection on Ark's Bermuda global property catastrophe excess of loss portfolio written in the 2023 underwriting year. Ark renewed its quota share reinsurance agreement with Outrigger Re Ltd. for the 2024, 2025 and 2026 underwriting years. White Mountains consolidates its segregated account of Outrigger Re Ltd., WM Outrigger Re, in its financial statements. White Mountains's capital commitment to WM Outrigger Re was $150 million for the 2025 underwriting year, $130 million for the 2024 underwriting year and $205 million for the 2023 underwriting year. WM Outrigger Re is not participating in the 2026 underwriting year; however, WM Outrigger Re remains exposed to losses that occur prior to the expiration of the 2025 underwriting year on June 30, 2026.

Ark is a specialty property and casualty insurance and reinsurance company that offers a wide range of niche insurance and reinsurance products. Ark underwrites select coverages through its two major subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Bermuda.

In the United Kingdom, Ark participates in the Lloyd's of London ("Lloyd's") market through Ark Corporate Member Limited ("ACML"), Ark's wholly-owned Lloyd's corporate member, which in turn provides underwriting capacity to Lloyd's Syndicates 4020 and 3902 and Additional Central Settlement Number ("ACSN") 3832 (collectively, the "Syndicates"). ACSN 3832 writes business on behalf of Syndicate 4020. Ark Syndicate Management Limited ("ASML"), Ark's wholly-owned Lloyd's managing agent, oversees the underwriting of the Syndicates. The Syndicates underwrite a diversified portfolio of insurance and reinsurance product lines, including property, specialty, marine & energy, casualty and accident & health. Syndicate 4020 commenced underwriting on April 1, 2007, Syndicate 3902 on January 1, 2017 and ACSN 3832 on July 1, 2024.

In Bermuda, Ark underwrites through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Group Ark Insurance Limited ("GAIL"), a Class 4 Bermuda-domiciled insurance and reinsurance company. GAIL underwrites a diversified portfolio of insurance and reinsurance product lines, including property, marine & energy, specialty, casualty and accident & health lines. GAIL commenced underwriting third-party business in January 2021. In addition, GAIL provides capital to support ACML's capital requirements at Lloyd's ("Funds at Lloyd's"). In November 2025, AM Best affirmed GAIL's financial strength rating at "A/stable."
In both jurisdictions, Ark underwrites business primarily through insurance and reinsurance brokers and wholesalers, both in the open market and through managing general agents ("MGAs").

As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, White Mountains reported $6,146 million and $5,134 million of total assets and $1,594 million and $1,438 million of total equity related to Ark. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, White Mountains owned 72.1% of Ark on a basic shares outstanding basis (61.9% after taking account of management's equity incentives) and reported $465 million and $410 million of noncontrolling interests related to Ark. The remaining shares are owned by current and former employees of Ark. In the future, management rollover shareholders could earn additional shares in Ark if and to the extent that White Mountains achieves certain thresholds for its multiple of invested capital return. If fully earned, these shares would represent an additional 12.3% of the shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025.

During the fourth quarter of 2022, Ark sponsored the formation of Outrigger Re Ltd., a Bermuda company registered as a special purpose insurer and segregated accounts company, to provide reinsurance capacity to Ark. Outrigger Re Ltd. was initially capitalized with $250 million of preference shares for business written in the 2023 underwriting year, of which White Mountains contributed $205 million. The remaining capital was provided by third-party investors. Outrigger Re Ltd. entered into collateralized quota share agreements with GAIL to provide reinsurance protection on Ark's Bermuda global property catastrophe excess of loss portfolio written in the 2023 underwriting year. The proceeds from the issuance of the preference shares were deposited into collateral trust accounts to fund any potential obligations under the reinsurance agreements with GAIL. Outrigger Re Ltd.'s obligations under the reinsurance agreements with GAIL are subject to an aggregate limit equal to the assets in the collateral trusts at any point in time. The terms of the reinsurance agreements are renewable upon the mutual agreement of Ark and the applicable preference shareholder of Outrigger Re Ltd.

During the fourth quarter of 2023, Ark renewed Outrigger Re Ltd. for the 2024 underwriting year with $250 million of capital. White Mountains rolled over $130 million from its commitment to the 2023 underwriting year. The remaining capital was provided by third-party investors.

Risks Related to Laws and Regulation

Other Risks Related to White Mountains and its Subsidiaries
We may suffer losses from unfavorable outcomes from litigation and other legal proceedings, which could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.
We depend on our key personnel to manage our business effectively, and they may be difficult to replace, which could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.
paragraphs: The information contained in this report may contain "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. See "FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS" on page 101 for specific important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in forward-looking statements. The Company's actual future results and trends may differ materially depending on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties discussed below.

We have successfully created shareholder value through acquisitions and dispositions. We may not be able to continue to create shareholder value through such transactions in the future, which could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

In past years, we have completed numerous acquisitions and dispositions, many of which have contributed significantly to creating shareholder value. Failure to identify and complete future acquisitions and dispositions could limit our ability to create shareholder value. Even if we were to identify and complete future acquisitions and dispositions, there is no assurance that such transactions will ultimately achieve their anticipated benefits, and such transactions could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

As of December 31, 2025, we had total goodwill and other intangible assets of $1,020 million on our consolidated balance sheet, of which $578 million relates to Distinguished and $293 million relates to Ark.

We periodically review goodwill and other intangible assets to determine whether an impairment has occurred. An impairment of goodwill or other intangible assets occurs when the carrying value of the asset exceeds its fair value. The evaluation of goodwill or other intangible assets for impairment requires the use of significant judgment in determining fair value, including assumptions about the future performance of the associated business. Our consolidated operating companies may experience unexpected circumstances that cause future performance to differ significantly from those assumptions, which could cause us to conclude that goodwill and other intangible assets are impaired. Such an impairment would result in a non-cash charge to income that could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

Ark underwrites insurance and reinsurance policies that cover unpredictable catastrophic events all over the world. Ark has exposure to losses caused by natural disasters and other events such as hurricanes, windstorms, earthquakes, floods, wildfires, tornadoes, tsunamis and severe weather. Catastrophes can also include large losses driven by public health crises, terrorist attacks, war and war-like actions, explosions, infrastructure failures and cyber attacks.

paragraphs: White Mountains ended 2025 with book value per share of $2,188, an increase of 25% for the year, including dividends.

The increase in book value per share was driven primarily by the net gain on sale of the Bamboo Group of approximately $320 per share (based on 2.54 million shares outstanding at December 5, 2025). In addition, the growth in White Mountains's book value per share reflected solid results at its operating companies and good investment returns.

Comprehensive income attributable to common shareholders was $1,109 million in 2025, largely driven by the net gain on sale of the Bamboo Group, compared to $230 million in 2024. White Mountains also recognized a net deferred tax expense of $73 million in 2025 from the reversal of the deferred tax asset related to the Bermuda economic transition adjustment, of which $51 million was recorded at Ark and $22 million was recorded at HG Global. Due to the enactment of Pillar II legislation by Luxembourg in December 2025, White Mountains no longer expects to utilize the benefit of the Bermuda economic transition adjustment.

On December 5, 2025, White Mountains completed the sale of a controlling financial interest in the Bamboo Group to affiliates of funds advised by CVC. White Mountains sold approximately 77.3% of its equity interest in the Bamboo Group for net cash proceeds at closing of $848 million and retained an indirect equity interest valued at $250 million. White Mountains's Other Operations recognized a net gain of $816 million, which was comprised of an $849 million net gain on sale of the Bamboo Group, partially offset by $33 million of parent company compensation costs recorded within general and administrative expenses.

On September 2, 2025, White Mountains closed its transaction to acquire a controlling financial interest in Distinguished, a full-service MGA and program administrator for specialty property & casualty insurance. White Mountains paid $225 million of cash consideration, including a post-closing purchase price adjustment of $1 million. In addition, Distinguished borrowed $50 million of incremental debt and utilized $7 million of cash on hand as part of the transaction.

On July 18, 2025, White Mountains closed its transaction to deploy $150 million into BroadStreet through the BroadStreet SPV, alongside co-lead investors Ethos Capital LP and British Columbia Investment Management Corporation. BroadStreet is an insurance brokerage company with a presence in all 50 U.S. states and ten Canadian provinces.

On April 1, 2025, White Mountains acquired a majority interest in Enterprise Solutions, a provider of specialty electrical contracting services. This was the first acquisition by WTM Partners. White Mountains paid $58 million of cash consideration, and Enterprise Solutions borrowed $15 million in new debt as part of the transaction.

In 2025, White Mountains repurchased and retired 100,581 of its common shares for $203 million at an average share price of $2,013.67, or 92% of White Mountains's December 31, 2025 book value per share. This included 64,064 shares repurchased through the self-tender offer in December.
Including a distribution of $128 million from WM Outrigger Re received in January, undeployed capital stands at roughly $1.0 billion.

The Ark/WM Outrigger segment's combined ratio was 81% in 2025 compared to 82% in 2024. The Ark/WM Outrigger segment reported gross written premiums of $2,557 million, net written premiums of $1,812 million and net earned premiums of $1,697 million in 2025 compared to gross written premiums of $2,207 million, net written premiums of $1,679 million and net earned premiums of $1,588 million in 2024. The Ark/WM Outrigger segment reported pre-tax income of $310 million in 2025 compared to $299 million in 2024.

Ark's combined ratio was 83% in both 2025 and 2024. Ark's combined ratio in 2025 included eight points of catastrophe losses, driven primarily by Hurricane Melissa and losses related to the January 2025 California wildfires, compared to 13 points of catastrophe losses in 2024, driven primarily by Hurricanes Milton, Helene, Debby and Beryl. Ark's combined ratio included seven points of net favorable prior year development in 2025, driven primarily by property and specialty lines of business. This included six points of unfavorable development related to aviation losses from the conflict in Ukraine and Russia. This compares to four points of net favorable prior year development in 2024, driven primarily by property and specialty lines of business.

Ark reported gross written premiums of $2,557 million, net written premiums of $1,727 million and net earned premiums of $1,613 million in 2025 compared to gross written premiums of $2,207 million, net written premiums of $1,593 million and net earned premiums of $1,500 million in 2024. Ark reported pre-tax income of $265 million in 2025 compared to $253 million in 2024. Ark's results included net realized and unrealized investment gains of $125 million in 2025 compared to $50 million in 2024. Ark's results in 2025 also included a $173 million of expense related to the increase in fair value of contingent consideration compared to $61 million in 2024. The increase in the contingent consideration liability was driven primarily by strong growth in Ark's tangible book value in the year. Ark's results in 2025 also included the reversal of the $51 million deferred tax asset associated with the Bermuda economic transition adjustment. In November 2025, A.M. Best affirmed Ark's "A/stable" financial strength rating and upgraded its issuer credit rating to "a+/stable".

WM Outrigger Re's combined ratio was 57% in 2025, compared to 60% in 2024. Catastrophe losses in the year ended December 31, 2025 included $19 million of losses related to the California wildfires (net of reinstatement premiums), primarily attributable to the 2024 underwriting year. WM Outrigger Re reported gross written premiums of $84 million and net earned premiums of $85 million in 2025 compared to gross written premiums of $87 million and net earned premiums of $88 million in 2024.

WM Outrigger Re reported pre-tax income (loss) of $45 million in 2025, of which $55 million was attributable to the 2025 underwriting year and $(10) million was attributable to the 2024 underwriting year. WM Outrigger Re reported pre-tax income of $46 million in 2024, of which $38 million was attributable to the 2024 underwriting year and $8 million was attributable to the 2023 underwriting year. Through December 31, 2025, WM Outrigger Re has generated pre-tax income of $55 million from the 2025 underwriting year, $29 million from the 2024 underwriting year and $76 million from the 2023 underwriting year.

paragraphs: White Mountains Insurance Group, Ltd. (the "Company" or the "Registrant") 為一家豁免的百慕達有限責任公司，其主要業務透過其子公司及附屬公司進行。在本報告中，"White Mountains" 一詞用以指稱根據上下文所需之合併組織內之一或多個實體。本公司總部位於 26 Reid Street, Hamilton, Bermuda HM 11，主要營業辦公室位於 23 South Main Street, Suite 3B, Hanover, New Hampshire 03755-2053，註冊辦公室位於 Clarendon House, 2 Church Street, Hamilton, Bermuda HM 11。本公司網站位於 www.whitemountains.com。位於 White Mountains 網站上的資訊未經引用納入本報告，亦非本報告之一部分。
White Mountains 從事機會性及價值導向的保險、金融服務及相關產業之企業與資產收購業務，並透過其子公司運作這些企業與資產，若在適當的退出價值出現時，則出售這些企業與資產。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，White Mountains 主要業務範圍為五大領域：財產與責任保險及再保險、市政債券擔保再保險、資產與財富管理機構之資本解決方案、專業保險分銷及其他業務。White Mountains 之財產與責任保險及再保險業務透過其子公司 Ark Insurance Holdings Limited 及其子公司（合稱 "Ark"）與 Outrigger Re Ltd. Segregated Account 2023-1（"WM Outrigger Re"）（合稱 "Ark/WM Outrigger"）進行。White Mountains 之市政債券擔保再保險業務透過其子公司 HG Global Ltd. 及其再保險子公司 HG Re Ltd.（"HG Re"）（合稱 "HG Global"）進行。White Mountains 透過其子公司 Kudu Investment Management, LLC 及其子公司（合稱 "Kudu"）為資產與財富管理機構提供資本解決方案。White Mountains 之專業保險分銷業務透過其子公司 WM Phoenix Parent, L.P. 及其子公司 d/b/a Distinguished Programs（合稱 "Distinguished"）進行。White Mountains 之其他業務包含本公司及其 wholly-owned 子公司 White Mountains Capital, LLC（"WM Capital"）、其其他中間控股公司、其 wholly-owned 投資管理子公司 White Mountains Advisors LLC（"WM Advisors"）、由 WM Advisors 管理之投資資產、其在 Bamboo Ide8 Insurance Services LLC（"Bamboo MGA"）及其子公司（合稱 "Bamboo"）透過特殊目的實體（"Bamboo SPV"）之權益、MediaAlpha, Inc.（"MediaAlpha"）、DavidShield PassportCard Ltd. 及其子公司（合稱 "PassportCard/DavidShield"）、BroadStreet Partners, Inc.（"BroadStreet"）透過特殊目的實體（"BroadStreet SPV"）、Elementum Holdings LP（"Elementum"）、White Mountains Partners LLC（"WTM Partners"）、Enterprise Electric, LLC d/b/a Enterprise Solutions（"Enterprise Solutions"）、兩項提供再保險容量給 Bamboo 之特殊目的擔保再保險實體（"Bamboo CRVs"）、其他合併及未合併實體（"Other Operating Businesses"）及某些其他資產（合稱 "Other Operations"）。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，White Mountains 之應報告分部為 Ark/WM Outrigger、HG Global、Kudu 及 Distinguished，其餘營運業務、控股公司及其他資產則列於 Other Operations。2025 年 12 月 5 日，White Mountains 完成對 Bamboo 之控制性財務權益出售。因此，White Mountains 於 2025 年 12 月 5 日將 Bamboo 從合併財務報表中剔除，Bamboo 不再為應報告分部。截至 2025 年 12 月 5 日，Bamboo 之營運結果列於 Bamboo 分部內。
Ark/WM Outrigger 分部包含 Ark 及 WM Outrigger Re。
2021 年 1 月 1 日，White Mountains 收購 Ark 之控制性股權（"Ark 交易"）。Ark 為一家專業財產與責任保險及再保險公司，提供廣泛之專業保險及再保險產品，包括財產、專業、海洋與能源、責任及意外與健康等產品。

2022 年第四季，Ark 發起設立 Outrigger Re Ltd.，為一家註冊於百慕達之特殊目的保險公司及分離帳戶公司，以提供對 Ark 之百慕達全球財產災害過失損失組合之擔保再保險保護，該組合於 2023 年承保年度承保。Ark 並於 2024、2025 及 2026 年承保年度與 Outrigger Re Ltd. 繼續其比例再保險協議。White Mountains 會將其 Outrigger Re Ltd. 之分離帳戶 WM Outrigger Re 納入財務報表中。White Mountains 對 WM Outrigger Re 之資本承諾為 2025 年承保年度 1.5 億美元、2024 年承保年度 1.3 億美元及 2023 年承保年度 2.05 億美元。WM Outrigger Re 不參與 2026 年承保年度；然而，WM Outrigger Re 仍對 2025 年承保年度 6 月 30 日前發生之損失有所風險。
Ark 為一家專業財產與責任保險及再保險公司，提供廣泛之專業保險及再保險產品。Ark 透過其在英國及百慕達之兩大子公司承保選擇性覆蓋範圍。

於英國，Ark 透過 Ark Corporate Member Limited（"ACML"），即 Ark 全資擁有之 Lloyd's 企業成員，參與倫敦勞埃德保險市場（"Lloyd's"）。ACML 進而為 Lloyd's 合約 4020 與 3902 及額外中央結算編號（"ACSN"）3832（合稱 "合約"）提供承保能力。ACSN 3832 代表合約 4020 進行業務。Ark Syndicate Management Limited（"ASML"），Ark 全資擁有之 Lloyd's 管理代理，監督合約的承保作業。合約承保一個多元化的保險與再保險產品線組合，包括財產、專業、海洋與能源、意外及傷害與健康。合約 4020 於 2007 年 4 月 1 日開始承保，合約 3902 於 2017 年 1 月 1 日開始承保，ACSN 3832 於 2024 年 7 月 1 日開始承保。

於百慕達，Ark 透過其全資子公司 Group Ark Insurance Limited（"GAIL"），一間百慕達註冊的第 4 類保險與再保險公司，進行承保作業。GAIL 承保一個多元化的保險與再保險產品線組合，包括財產、海洋與能源、專業、意外及傷害與健康。GAIL 於 2021 年 1 月開始承保第三方業務。此外，GAIL 提供資本以支援 ACML 在 Lloyd's 的資本需求（"Lloyd's 資本"）。2025 年 11 月，AM Best 將 GAIL 的財務強度評級維持在 "A/stable"。
在這兩個司法管轄區，Ark 主要透過保險與再保險經紀商及經銷商進行業務承保，包括公開市場及透過管理總代理（"MGAs"）。

於 2022 年第四季，Ark 贊助成立 Outrigger Re Ltd.，一間註冊為特殊目的保險公司及分戶帳戶公司的百慕達公司，以提供再保險能力給 Ark。Outrigger Re Ltd. 初期以 2.5 億美元的優先股資本化，用於 2023 年承保年寫入的業務，其中 White Mountains 貢獻 2.05 億美元。剩餘資本由第三方投資者提供。Outrigger Re Ltd. 與 GAIL 籤訂擔保比例分擔協議，以提供再保險保護，針對 Ark 在百慕達全球財產災害過失損失組合於 2023 年承保年寫入的業務。發行優先股所得資金存入擔保信託帳戶，以資助與 GAIL 再保險協議下任何潛在義務。Outrigger Re Ltd. 與 GAIL 的再保險協議義務，受擔保信託帳戶內資產總額的總體限制。再保險協議的條款可在 Ark 與 Outrigger Re Ltd. 相關優先股東雙方同意下重續。
於 2023 年第四季，Ark 為 2024 年承保年重續 Outrigger Re Ltd.，資本為 2.5 億美元。White Mountains 從 2023 年承保年的承諾中轉移 1.3 億美元。剩餘資本由第三方投資者提供。

paragraphs: White Mountains 以每股 $2,188 的帳面價值結束 2025 年，較去年成長 25%，包含股息在內。
每股帳面價值的增加主要由出售竹 Bamboo Group 約 320 美元的淨收益所驅動（基於 2025 年 12 月 5 日發行在外 2.54 百萬股）。此外，White Mountains 每股帳面價值的成長反映了其營運公司表現穩健以及投資回報良好。

歸屬於普通股股東的綜合損益為 1,109 百萬美元，主要由出售 Bamboo Group 的淨獲利所驅動，與 2024 年的 230 百萬美元相比。White Mountains 在 2025 年亦認列與 Bermuda 經濟轉型調整相關的遞延稅資產回轉所產生的淨遞延稅費用 73 百萬美元，其中 51 百萬美元計入 Ark，22 百萬美元計入 HG Global。由於盧森堡於 2025 年 12 月通過 Pillar II 法規，White Mountains 不再預期能利用 Bermuda 經濟轉型調整的優惠。

2025 年 12 月 5 日，White Mountains 完成將 Bamboo Group 的控制性財務權益出售給 CVC 所屬基金的關聯公司。White Mountains 出售約 77.3% 的 Bamboo Group 股權，獲取淨現金 848 百萬美元，並保留間接權益價值為 250 百萬美元。White Mountains 的其他營運業務認列淨獲利 816 百萬美元，包含出售 Bamboo Group 的淨獲利 849 百萬美元，扣除 33 百萬美元的母公司補償費用（計入一般及行政費用）。

2025 年 9 月 2 日，White Mountains 完成對 Distinguished 的交易，取得其控制性財務權益。Distinguished 是一家提供全方位服務的 MGA 及專案管理人，專門從事特殊財產與責任保險業務。White Mountains 支付現金 225 百萬美元作為對價，包含後續購價調整 1 百萬美元。此外，Distinguished 借入 50 百萬美元的額外債務，並使用 7 百萬美元現金作為交易的一部分。

2025 年 7 月 18 日，White Mountains 完成透過 BroadStreet SPV 向 BroadStreet 投資 150 百萬美元的交易，與共同領投投資者 Ethos Capital LP 及 British Columbia Investment Management Corporation 同時進行。BroadStreet 是一家保險經紀公司，業務遍及美國所有 50 個州及加拿大 10 個省份。

2025 年 4 月 1 日，White Mountains 取得 Enterprise Solutions 的多數股權，Enterprise Solutions 是一家提供特殊電氣 contracting 服務的供應商。這是 WTM Partners 的首宗收購。White Mountains 支付現金 58 百萬美元作為對價，並 Enterprise Solutions 借入 15 百萬美元的新債務作為交易的一部分。
2025 年，White Mountains 回購並註銷 100,581 股普通股，總計支付 203 百萬美元，平均每股價格為 2,013.67 美元，或為 White Mountains 2025 年 12 月 31 日每股書面價值的 92%。此交易包含 64,064 股透過 12 月自願標單購回。
包含於1月收到WM Outrigger Re的$1.28億美元分紅，未動用資本約為$10億美元。

Ark/WM Outrigger分部的綜合損益率在2025年為81%，較2024年的82%為低。Ark/WM Outrigger分部在2025年報告的毛寫保費為$25.57億美元，淨寫保費為$18.12億美元，淨已賺保費為$16.97億美元，較2024年的毛寫保費$22.07億美元、淨寫保費$16.79億美元及淨已賺保費$15.88億美元為高。Ark/WM Outrigger分部在2025年報告的稅前收入為$3.10億美元，較2024年的$2.99億美元為高。

Ark的綜合損益率在2025年及2024年均為83%。2025年Ark的綜合損益率包含8點災害損失，主要由Hurricane Melissa及2025年1月加州山火相關損失所驅動，較2024年的13點災害損失（主要由Hurricanes Milton、Helene、Debby及Beryl所驅動）為低。Ark的綜合損益率包含2025年7點淨有利的前一年發展，主要由財產及專業業務線所驅動。此包含6點不利的發展，與烏克蘭及俄羅斯衝突所導致的航空損失有關。這與2024年的4點淨有利的前一年發展（主要由財產及專業業務線所驅動）相比。

Ark在2025年報告的毛寫保費為$25.57億美元，淨寫保費為$17.27億美元，淨已賺保費為$16.13億美元，較2024年的毛寫保費$22.07億美元、淨寫保費$15.93億美元及淨已賺保費$15.00億美元為高。Ark在2025年報告的稅前收入為$2.65億美元，較2024年的$2.53億美元為高。Ark在2025年的結果包含淨實現及未實現投資獲利$1.25億美元，較2024年的$5000萬美元為高。Ark在2025年的結果也包含與應計考慮金額公允價值增加相關的費用$1.73億美元，較2024年的$6100萬美元為高。應計考慮金額負債的增加主要由Ark的實質帳本價值在該年度的強勁成長所驅動。Ark在2025年的結果也包含與伯明翰經濟轉型調整相關的$5100萬美元遞延所得稅資產的轉回。2025年11月，A.M. Best確認Ark的「A/穩定」財務強度評級，並將其發行者信用評級提升至「a+/穩定」。

WM Outrigger Re的綜合損益率在2025年為57%，較2024年的60%為低。截至2025年12月31日的年度，災害損失包含與加州山火相關的$1900萬美元損失（扣除重複賠償 premiums），主要歸因於2024年度的承保年份。WM Outrigger Re在2025年報告的毛寫保費為$8400萬美元，淨已賺保費為$8500萬美元，較2024年的毛寫保費$8700萬美元及淨已賺保費$8800萬美元為低。

WM Outrigger Re在2025年報告的稅前收入（損失）為$4500萬美元，其中$5500萬美元歸因於2025年度的承保年份，$(10)萬美元歸因於2024年度的承保年份。WM Outrigger Re在2024年報告的稅前收入為$4600萬美元，其中$3800萬美元歸因於2024年度的承保年份，$800萬美元歸因於2023年度的承保年份。截至2025年12月31日，WM Outrigger Re從2025年度承保年份產生的稅前收入為$5500萬美元，從2024年度承保年份產生的稅前收入為$2900萬美元，從2023年度承保年份產生的稅前收入為$7600萬美元。

headings: 若本公司需對商譽及其他無形資產進行減值提列，可能會對本公司營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與Ark/WM Outrigger業務與產業相關之風險
無法預測之大規模災難事件可能會對本公司營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
Ark可能無法透過再保險與後備保險安排充分降低風險，這可能會對本公司營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
Ark的損失與LAE準備金可能不足以覆蓋最終的損失責任，這可能會對本公司營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與HG Global業務與產業相關之風險
本公司透過HG Re與BAM之間的再保險條約，可能面臨由BAM承保之市政債券保險所導致之損失，這可能會對本公司營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若 BAM 未能支付 BAM Surplus Notes 部分或全部的本金及利息，可能會顯著不利影響我們的營運成果與財務狀況。
我們可能因 BAM Surplus Notes 的評價波動而面臨風險，這可能會顯著不利影響我們的營運成果與財務狀況。
與 Kudu 事業與產業相關的風險
與 Distinguished 事業與產業相關的風險
我們可能因對 MediaAlpha 的投資而面臨波動，這可能會顯著不利影響我們的營運成果與財務狀況。
我們可能被視為 PFIC，此情況下，美國投資人持有我們普通股可能會面臨美國聯邦所得稅法中不利的規則。
本公司及部分非美國子公司可能成為美國稅務的納稅義務人，這可能會對我們的營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
稅法或稅務條約的變更可能會對我們的營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們的非美國子公司被視為美國國稅局所定義的受控外國公司（CFCs），可能會使美國持有我們普通股10%以上的股東面臨美國聯邦所得稅法中不利的規則。
擬議的規範可能會使美國籍股東面臨美國聯邦所得稅法中關於『相關人保險收入』的不利規則。
與法律及法規相關的風險
法規可能會對我們的營運及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
百慕達法律與美國現行法律有所不同，可能對股東提供的保護較少。
如果我們為確保符合指南、政策及法律與法規標準而設計的控制措施未能有效運作，可能會對我們造成重大不利影響。
其他與White Mountains及其子公司相關的風險
我們可能因訴訟及其他法律程序的不利結果而遭受損失，這可能會重大且負面地影響我們的營運結果及財務狀況。
我們依賴關鍵人員有效地管理業務，而這些人員可能難以取代，這可能會重大且負面地影響我們的營運結果及財務狀況。
paragraphs: 本報告所包含之資訊可能包含依 1933 年證券交易法第 27A 節及 1934 年證券交易所法第 21E 節定義之「向前看聲明」。請參閱第 101 頁之「向前看聲明」，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與向前看聲明中所載結果有重大差異之重要因素。本公司未來實際結果及趨勢可能因多種因素而有重大差異，包括但不限於下文所討論之風險與不確定性。
我們已透過收購與出售活動成功創造股東價值。我們未來可能無法繼續透過此類交易創造股東價值，這可能會對我們之營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
在過去幾年，我們已完成許多收購與出售活動，其中許多已對創造股東價值產生重大貢獻。未能識別並完成未來之收購與出售活動，可能會限制我們創造股東價值之能力。即使我們識別並完成未來之收購與出售活動，也無法保證這些交易最終會實現預期之效益，且這些交易可能對我們之營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們之合併資產負債表中總計 goodwill 及其他無形資產為 10.2 億美元，其中 5.78 億美元與 Distinguished 有關，2.93 億美元與 Ark 有關。

我們會定期評估 goodwill 及其他無形資產，以判斷是否發生減損。當資產之帳面價值高於其公允價值時，即發生 goodwill 或其他無形資產之減損。評估 goodwill 或其他無形資產是否減損，需使用重大判斷以確定公允價值，包括對相關業務未來表現之假設。我們之合併營運公司可能遭遇未預期之情況，導致未來表現與這些假設有重大差異，這可能會導致我們結論為 goodwill 及其他無形資產已減損。此種減損將導致對營業收入之非現金費用，可能對我們之營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
Ark 承辦保險與再保險政策，覆蓋全球範圍內預測不到之大規模災害事件。Ark 面臨因自然災害及其他事件（如颶風、風暴、地震、洪水、野火、龍捲風、海嘯及極端天氣）所導致之損失。災難亦可能包括由公共衛生危機、恐怖攻擊、戰爭及戰爭行為、爆炸、基礎建設失敗及網路攻擊所導致之重大損失。
